text: Channel's open, Kam. Messages you type here land in my dashboard inbox — I read them at every session boot and check-in, and my replies appear right here. It's asynchronous for now (live back-and-forth is the WED-51 comms build); for anything urgent the usual channels still win.
this is a test of the feature.  can we add to the customisation to put separators.
Is the new layout and organisation saved?  Can I create a couple favourite views?
Can I add colours (pale or subtle colours) to the tiles in customise?

Caught your three messages — answers: (1) Yes, everything in organise/customise is saved (drag order, widths, heights, text size, hidden tiles, and this chat view) and survives restarts. (2) Named favourite views — not yet; logging it now as the next dashboard round, together with (3) section separators and pale tile colours in customise. This view you're in IS the first saved view; named ones (e.g. 'chat with Wed', 'morning review') come with that round. And this reply came from my session live — the mirror works both ways.
fantastic.  thank you!! its all taking shape well.  Once an item has been actioned, archive it and create a button at the top where I can see items archived. and one ffor items being actioned

Seen and folded in — the build agent is on it right now: grid separators, the received/actioning marks (honest ticks: they flip when I actually read the item, only 'action now' is instant), plus your two new topbar buttons — 'actioning' and 'archived' — with actioned items flowing into archived automatically. Views and tile colours already shipped: try the ☆ views button, your 'chat with Wed' view is saved there.

Round 2 shipped and verified — separators, the honest ticks (your four asks from today already show green ✓ done), 'action now' in the right-click, and the actioning/archived buttons up top. I left two demo separators (Work, World & News) — remove or rename them in customise. Wrapping for the day now; the board, this chat, and the archived panel will be exactly as you left them tomorrow. Good night, Kam.

Make each of these 2 take up 50% of the width.  2)wher echat with Wednesday was, create a "Personal Actions" item. this should be a task list (linked to wednesday linear tickets tagged as personal..  there should be an option to create these tickets, prioritise and action

Seen — and first, honestly: your 08:45 message sat here three hours because nothing watches this chat the way the watcher now watches the fleet mail. That gap gets its enforcement today (the same runner will watch this file), and it's going in the ledger. Your changes: (1) chat tile moving to the bottom next to news, 50/50 widths — doing that now, small round. (2) 'Personal Actions' tile in chat's old spot — task list wired to my Linear tickets tagged 'personal', with create/prioritise/action — that's a proper build, so a teammate is on it while I stay here; I'll verify and ping you when it's live. Your post-meeting flag queue is also ready in the session — nine items, one-word answers.
